notes:
Account snapshot: mid-stage enterprise evaluation for RAG + code search. Core ask: high-quality embeddings + reranking for massive code corpus; frequent re-indexing and low per-query cost.

Context / business drivers:
- Product: internal developer tooling + customer-facing code search (IDE plugin + web portal).
- Wants semantic code search that surfaces exact snippets + ranked results for relevance and licensing metadata.
- Heavy emphasis on infra economics: target <$0.005/query blended (embedding + rerank).
- Compliance: must support SSO via SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, and EU/NA data residency.

Technical scale and constraints:
- Corpus: ~50M embeddings currently (sources: github enterprise + internal monorepos). Growing ~10% monthly.
- Update pattern: nightly full-ish reindex + continuous incremental updates (webhooks from CI). Need fast incremental ingestion and background compaction.
- Query profile: 60% developer short queries (<=8 tokens), 30% long-context searches (stack traces), 10% bulk analytics rerank jobs.
- Latency targets: end-to-end rerank+embed <150ms p50, <350ms p95 for interactive UI. Batch analytics can be relaxed.
- Model preferences: open models for embeddings (quantized LLM variants preferred), cross-encoder rerankers for top-100 candidate rerank on Dedicated. Consider Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization profiles.

What they've tested so far:
- Proof-of-concept on managed vector store (competing vendor) — good relevance but cost and tail latency at scale unacceptable.
- Local microbenchmarks using faiss + cross-encoder ran into GPU memory fragmentation when reranking top-200 candidates.

Security / procurement notes:
- Internal legal sent initial NDA; security sent questionnaire (Drive link above) — KMS + SOC2 evidence required.
- Data residency: want EU+NA split; Private deployment or VPC Dedicated likely.
- SSO: initial SAML metadata received; want IdP-provisioning during POC.

POC plan (agreed):
- Phase 1 (week 0-1): ingest 5M representative vectors into Dedicated test pool; validate index build time and incremental update latency.
- Phase 2 (week 2): scale to 50M vectors, run traffic replay at 2x expected QPS; measure p50/p95 latency, token cost, and rerank accuracy (MAP/NDCG).
- Phase 3 (week 3-4): security runbook, VPC peering test, KMS encryption, SAML SSO smoke test.

Quotes / call paraphrases:
- "We need predictable economics — spikes kill our margins." (Head of Infra)
- "If rerank takes >300ms our devs won't adopt." (CTO)
